tagline: The booking.com of international freight logistics
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of bookings on the platform is the primary indicator of growth and marketplace liquidity, a key driver of the expansion and monetization strategy.

kpis.name: Number of bookings on the platform
kpis.explanation: Total number of freight transactions booked via the platform.
kpis.description: The chart shows a continuous increase in bookings, particularly for older cohorts, indicating strong retention and adoption.

kpis.name: Active carriers on the platform
kpis.explanation: Number of active air and ocean carriers on the platform.
kpis.description: 77 active carriers, including 19 of the top 20, reinforce network credibility and coverage.

kpis.name: Freight forwarder customers
kpis.explanation: Number of freight forwarders using the platform.
kpis.description: 4,000+ freight forwarders, including all 20 of the top 20, demonstrate massive demand-side adoption.
kpis.signal: Deep penetration into the large freight forwarder segment

kpis.name: Unique buyer users
kpis.explanation: Number of importers/exporters using the platform to book.
kpis.description: 20,700 unique buyer users, including over 13,000 enterprises, show increasing adoption on the import/export side.

kpis.name: Solutions Revenue (SaaS)
kpis.explanation: Revenue from SaaS subscriptions, data, and procurement tools.
kpis.description: Recurring revenue from SaaS solutions, key for margin and financial stability. Growth of 27% YoY for 2025 compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Platform Revenue (transaction fees)
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated on each booked freight transaction.
kpis.description: Fees based on transaction volume, with a percentage-of-GBV model on the forwarder-shipper side. Growth of 18% YoY for 2025.
kpis.signal: Accelerated growth driven by marketplace liquidity

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin after direct costs.
kpis.description: High gross margin due to absence of direct logistics costs, pure digital model. 67% in 2025 vs 65% in 2024.
kpis.signal: High margin typical of SaaS and marketplace models

kpis.name: R&D (as % of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D maintained at 41% of revenue for 2025 (vs 43% in 2024), aligned with tech leaders to strengthen product features.

risks.title: Insufficient adoption of SaaS software solutions
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Item 1A with highly intense language ("severely limited", "stagnate"). 2026 strategy fully dependent on Solutions adoption. Trend: up (new pivot strategy). Critical weight: major commercial transition.

risks.title: Critical dependence on attracting and retaining users
risks.score_rationale: Second major risk extensively detailed (multiple paragraphs). Strong language: "could significantly hinder", "adversely affect". Systemic risk: without carriers/forwarders/importers, no network effects. Trend: stable (permanent structural risk).

risks.title: History of net losses and lack of profitability
risks.score_rationale: Structural financial risk explicitly addressed. Losses of $17.5M (2025) and $22.5M (2024). Language: "foreseeable future". No positive operating cash flow. Trend: stable (chronic risk). Weight: direct impact on long-term viability.

risks.title: Technology risk: transition to native operations and AI
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named at the end of the section. Language: "fundamentally disrupt", "render obsolete". Accelerated transformation by generative AI and autonomous agents. Trend: up (accelerating technology). Weight: existential threat to the platform.

risks.title: Intense competition in the LogTech industry
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in forward-looking statements ("fiercely competitive LogTech industry"). Intense language. Trend: stable (structural competition). Weight: direct threat to market share and growth.

risks.title: Dependence on a limited number of logistics service providers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified in forward-looking statements. Language: "limited number of sellers". Supply concentration creates vulnerability. Trend: stable (structural risk). Weight: direct impact on service quality and platform attractiveness.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and risks of computer system sabotage
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements and Item 16K. Language: "cyberattacks", "sabotage", "numerous adverse impacts". Dependence on vendors/users/contractors. Trend: up (growing threat). Weight: major operational and reputational impact.

risks.title: Complex regulatory compliance (data, customs, taxes)
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in forward-looking statements: "complex regulatory environment", "data privacy", "customs clearance". Language: "avoid penalties". Multinational operations amplify complexity. Trend: up (increasing regulation). Weight: risk of penalties and operational disruption.

ai_positioning.summary: Freightos is gradually integrating AI capabilities into its pricing and demand management tools, including predictive analytics and real-time recommendations.
